_meta.purpose: Robot tests that fail because of an open SUT defect. They carry the known-bug tag and run with --skiponfailure known-bug, so a known defect is reported as skipped instead of failing the run.
_meta.source: Bug IDs and issue links are the ones in e2e/automation/data/known_failures.json for the same defect.
_meta.verified_against: Local runs on 2026-11-21 against the backend that tests/__init__.robot starts: each listed test failed with the messages in expect_error.
_meta.kinds: bug = confirmed defect, same meaning as in the e2e file
_meta.expect_error: Substrings that must all appear in the failure message. .github/scripts/check-robot-known-failures.py fails the job when a listed test passed, failed for another reason, or has no entry.
